status: frozen at the commit that adds this file (P2). Change only by a separate commit with the reason in the run OUTBOX. The generator never writes this file.
rule: A generated theorem may use only these premise classes. A premise outside this list is a new trust assumption: stop and report.

classes.what: runtime callee as a hypothesis in Kraken form (CONTRACTS.md section 2): MakesliceC, MemmoveC, GrowsliceC, NewobjectC, ConvT64C, FmtErrorfNilC, FmtErrorfWC, FmtErrorfDWC, ValidateBitlistC, ValidateBitlistErrC
classes.conditions: quantified over all states, return addresses and frames; argument conditions, budgets, scratch S and spill as in CONTRACTS.md; each contract has an abstract model and joint satisfiability (joint_models)
classes.new_contract: a new runtime callee (for example runtime.moveSliceNoCapNoScan, a new fmt format shape) needs its own entry, model and witness; it is a list change

classes.what: a callee that is itself proved (generated method of another type, ssz.ValidateBitvector): a spec derived from its theorem (*_holds)
classes.conditions: the spec's own contracts propagate to the caller's completion row

classes.what: a hand-written Go method called by generated code (Prysm consensus-types/primitives SSZ methods)
classes.conditions: allowed only as a function spec proved from its own machine code, or as a named contract listed here with a model; not yet present; adding one is a list change

classes.what: frame R (any separated resource) preserved by every main theorem
heap budget `avail`, runtime-owned blocks in contracts
classes.conditions: numbers budgets, not physical address space claims (REPORT 7.2)
checked on the real layout by the link check; on concrete Hosts by Lean theorems

classes.what: label addresses of globals (ssz.Err*, runtime.writeBarrier, runtime.staticuint64s, itabs, type descriptors)
classes.conditions: premise; link check / fix3 data include confirms on the ELF

classes.what: ssz.Err* values after package init: e0 != 0 and the itab word readable
classes.conditions: premise; must be connected to the witness (astra finding 4); a nil global is not allowed in a reject witness

classes.what: rodata strings, itabs, type descriptors, staticuint64s as bytes from the ELF (fix3 data include, Fk.Data.<id>)
classes.conditions: premise shape `Eq (bytes.At addr)`; bytes and addr come from Fk.Data only; hand constants are not allowed
fast-path premise; callee stack growth is outside contracts
fast-path premise; GC during the call is outside
only where the hand case uses it (ListC empty accept); reject paths do not assume it

classes.what: Go ABIInternal amd64 argument registers and return slot
classes.conditions: Go 1.26.x ABIInternal; Go 1.26.10 for the phase1c namespace

classes.what: input, receiver, stack and output pairwise disjoint (⋆)
bool byte in {0,1}, len <= cap < 2^63, object size/alignment/padding
classes.conditions: theorems may allow more; witnesses must be Go values (goval / later Lean predicate)
no quantification over all sizes and all frames (fv/AGENTS.md)

forbidden: a premise that makes the conclusion vacuous (False derivable)
dropping a live resource into `⋆ True` without classification
